name: What is the typical cost for repairing a roof leak after a storm?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost for repairing a roof leak after a storm?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of repairing a roof leak after a storm can vary widely depending on the extent of the damage, the type of roofing materials, and the complexity of the repair. Minor leaks involving a few shingles might be less expensive than extensive damage requiring large sections of roof replacement or structural repairs. A professional assessment is necessary to provide an accurate estimate. Many repairs may be covered by homeowner's insurance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair costs vary greatly based on damage severity and roof type. A professional assessment is needed for an accurate estimate, and insurance often covers it.
